cases.refreshed: A well-crafted resume and cover letter are vital tools for helping you stand out to potential employers. Parking validation for the garage at 88 S. 4th Street will be provided at the program. E-newsletter Signup: Get the inside scoop on business and career resources at SJPL. cases.refreshed: Baby/Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. This program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome. Free, with limited capacity. Seating for storytime is available on a first-come, first-served basis. A limited number of tickets will be distributed at the Information Desk 30 minutes prior to the start of storytime. Child must be present to receive a ticket. This program has been generously sponsored by the Friends of the Vineland Branch Library. San José Public Library Storytimes are in alignment with the City's Education and Digital Literacy Initiative.

cases.refreshed: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning. Children will enjoy one-on-one or small-group interaction with our volunteer. They are also welcome to practice reading to our volunteer. Pre-registration is not required, and children may drop in to hear a story any time during the program. This program is best suited for preschoolers and children in grades K-3 and will be held in the Children's Picture Book area. This program runs concurrently with our Baby & Toddler Storytime and offers young ones a quieter/low-energy alternative. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Wanna seal the deal? Join us for an interview workshop focusing on interview strategies specifically in closing statements with an emphasis on what to do and what to avoid. Sometimes we are having a great interview and yet fall short at the end. Based on the principle of recency--how the last thing you say is what your interviewers may remember the most--we provide strategies to help you make that lasting positive impression. This programs is followed immediately by: Navigating difficult conversations at work In partnership with SJSU Department of Communication Studies Free. No registration required. Parking validation for the garage at 88 S. 4th Street will be provided at the program. E-newsletter Signup: Get the inside scoop on business and career resources at SJPL. Sign up today for our monthly e-newsletter, highlighting the latest programs, e-resources and services available at the San José Public Library. #sjplworkscareer

cases.refreshed: Join us for a fun, interactive, and informative event at Cupertino library with Alyanna Poniente, pediatric occupational therapist from Development Is Child's Play, as she explores sensory regulation and resources for babies and toddlers! Discover playful ways to support your child's development, explore sensory resources available at Cupertino Library, and learn how to bring sensory play into your home and daily routines. Each family will receive a take-home handout, and there will be time for questions after the presentation. Space is limited to 30 families. For babies and toddlers with their parent/caregivers. Generously sponsored by the Friends of Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
